family: paid creature arrival and delayed return

cases.name: Shifty Doppelganger
cases.text: {3}{U}, Exile this creature: You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. If you do, that creature gains haste until end of turn. At the beginning of the next end step, sacrifice that creature. If you do, return this card to the battlefield.
